about_the_game:
A full featured virtual operating system simulation where you explore, create, and uncover mysterious lost media through interactive desktop activities.

Gameplay: Navigate through WASTE OS using familiar desktop interactions - click through folders, launch applications, and piece together fragmented digital artifacts.

Core Activities:

Create and customize - Use the built-in drawing tools to create artwork and write notes

Social discovery - Connect with other players by sharing your creations and discoveries through Steam Workshop integration.

content_descriptors.notes: A desktop stripper that dances on the desktop.
